### Haves and Have-Nots
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/haves-and-have-nots-one-year-devotions-for-men-september-23.html
Passage: Exodus 23:6, 9
Points:
- God gave Israel clear moral instructions to protect the poor, foreigners, and other vulnerable groups from exploitation.
- The command to treat underprivileged people justly is grounded in their inherent dignity as bearers of God's image.
- Christian concern for the marginalized arises from biblical love and compassion rather than political ideology.
- Modern business ethics and daily work must temper the profit motive with generosity, fairness, and care for people.

### Bible Pathways - Jan. 25, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-jan-25-2008-11565991.html
Passage: Exodus 23:1-2
Points:
- Sins of the tongue, especially gossip and false reports, are subtle but deeply destructive before God.
- Scripture forbids not only repeating slanderous words, but also being willing to listen to them.
- Believers must resist peer pressure and refuse to follow the crowd into unrighteousness or injustice.
- Slander harms the reputation of others while severely damaging a believer's spiritual testimony and service to God.
